title: Geekvape J Replacement Vape Pods
description: GeekVape J Replacement Pods are precision-engineered for use with the GeekVape Digi Pro and Digi Max Pod Kits, delivering exceptional flavour, versatility, and convenience. Each pod holds 2ml of e-liquid and features an integrated coil design, removing the need for separate coil changes. This makes the J Pods a perfect choice for vapers seeking a straightforward and reliable option. With their leak-resistant top-fill system, these pods are easy to refill and ensure a mess-free experience. Available in four resistances—0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, and 1.2ohm—these pods cater to a variety of vaping preferences. The 0.4ohm and 0.6ohm pods are tailored for restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping, offering dense vapour and bold flavour with 50/50 or high-VG e-liquids. For mouth-to-lung (MTL) enthusiasts, the 0.8ohm and 1.2ohm pods deliver a satisfying, tighter draw that works beautifully with 50/50 and nicotine salt e-liquids. GeekVape J Replacement Pods attach securely to your device with a strong magnetic base, providing a stable and seamless vaping experience. Whether you prefer bold vapour or a smoother, more discreet draw, these pods are an ideal companion for all vaping styles. Pod Details: 0.2ohm DTL- This pod is ONLY Compatible with the Digi Max Kit - Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-liquid ONLY. 0.3ohm DM (Dual Mesh) RDL - Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-liquid ONLY. 0.4ohm RDL - Use High VG (Sub-Ohm) E-liquid ONLY. 0.6ohm RDL/MTL - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 Freebase E-Liquid. 0.8ohm MTL - Use Nic Salts or 50/50 Freebase E-Liquid. 1.2ohm MTL - Use 50/50 Freebase or High PG E-Liquid. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
